==Description==
The '''Speedy Elf''' was an enemy that exclusively appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had a slightly fast speed and a somewhat high amount of health for its debut.

==Appearance==
The '''Speedy Elf''' had pale skin. It had a light blue shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black belt, dark cyan pants and black shoes. It also wore a blue Christmas hat with a lightning bolt emblem on it.

==Strategy==
*Early game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Cowboy]], [[Golden Cowboy]], [[Militant]] or [[Crook Boss]] can do quite well against these.
*As these enemies spawn in large numbers, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Executioner]] can be useful against this.
*Later on during the game, stronger towers like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Minigunner]] can kill the '''Speedy Elf''' quite easily.
